evidence_boundary.purpose: Coverage-complete fixed-trajectory factorial diagnostic of the frozen M1, M2, and M3 formulas on the exact continuous historical route responses.
evidence_boundary.positive_result_permission: A positive result is diagnostic support only and cannot authorize VM Release parity, closed-loop smoke, or formal closed-loop runs because the full-grid runtime bank has a separately frozen coverage failure.
evidence_boundary.negative_result_permission: A failed module gate is sufficient to reject that module under the frozen formulas; no rescue tuning is permitted.

factorial_arms.F00: M1 raw event plus count-only score (runtime cpir_a1)
factorial_arms.F01: M1 raw event plus M3 stop-resolved score (runtime cpir_m1_m3)
factorial_arms.F10: M1 plus M2 persistent state plus count-only score (runtime cpir_a2)
factorial_arms.F11: M1 plus M2 persistent state plus M3 stop-resolved score (runtime cpir_a3)

trajectory_metrics.final_error: official final posterior at T=300 s
trajectory_metrics.error_auc: trapezoidal integration at t=0, the five common source-update times, and T=300 s; t=0 is the common geometry-only uniform free-cell prior
trajectory_metrics.time_to_2m: first common source-update time with official error <=2.0 m; use t=0 if the common prior already satisfies it; otherwise right-censor at 300 s
trajectory_metrics.final_rank: true-source carrier normalized rank at T

fixed_statistics.clear_increment: right-arm pooled mean is lower, pairwise wins exceed losses, and the one-sided exact sign-test p-value excluding ties is <=0.05
fixed_statistics.significant_final_worsening: the one-sided exact sign-test for right-arm final error being larger is <=0.05
fixed_statistics.stable_house_reverse: within a House, right-arm mean is larger and at least 8 of 10 pairs are worse
fixed_statistics.cross_house_repeatability: the selected improved metric has a lower mean in at least two of three Houses and no House meets stable_house_reverse

requirements: at least one of final_error, error_auc, time_to_2m, or final_rank is a clear increment for F00 versus A0
the selected metric is cross-House repeatable
F00 final error does not significantly worsen versus A0

m2_prediction_gate.unit: one historical held-out observation tape; score the true source carrier's per-stop predictive event probabilities
m2_prediction_gate.pass: persistent-state pooled NLL and Brier are both lower than raw-event values, at least one has one-sided paired sign p<=0.05 across 30 tapes, fixed-bin ECE is not larger, and neither NLL nor Brier has a stable House reverse

requirements: at least one of final_error, error_auc, or time_to_2m is a clear increment for F11 versus F01
the selected metric is cross-House repeatable
F11 final error does not significantly worsen versus F01

m3_gate.stop_permute: for each House, seed, and visible prefix, apply one SHA256-domain-separated deterministic non-identity permutation to candidate raw-event stop labels while preserving the observed tape and hit count
requirements: F01 versus F00 has a clear increment in final_error or error_auc
final true-source normalized rank changes in the same direction
F01 final error does not significantly worsen versus F00
F01 beats STOP_PERMUTE in final_error or error_auc with one-sided exact sign p<=0.05 and rank in the same direction
the F01 versus F00 selected metric improves in at least two Houses and has no stable House reverse

overall_pass: M1, M2, and M3 gates all pass and the pooled means show A0 -> F00 -> F01 -> F11 monotone improvement in final_error or error_auc
forbidden: claim full-grid runtime validity from route-diagnostic evidence
start VM Release parity or any closed-loop run from this diagnostic
change M1, M2, or M3 scientific formulas or constants
restore dynamic-K, coherent-K, exact first-passage, or neural hazard
